  • You write clearly and can turn complex or incomplete information into structured next steps.

  • You can recognize when a global idea may need adaptation for Japan or Australia, and explain why.

  • You are organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable following through across multiple stakeholders.

  • You ask useful clarifying questions, identify missing context, and raise risks constructively.

Previous marketing experience is welcome but not essential. We are interested in transferable experience from studies, student organizations, internships, projects, or other environments where you have built processes and coordinated work.

  • Duration : 6 months

  • Full-time internship (35h/week)

  • Location : Paris (France)

  • Skill fit interview and live case study with a team member (45min)

  • Video-call Interview with the Talent Acquisition Specialist (30 min)

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.

- Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.

- Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

title: Solution Engineer (f/m/d)
Marketing Manager
description:
At Parallel, we build AI agents to help healthcare facilities automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding.


Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost in manual, repetitive administrative work. Legacy software hasn’t helped, it’s made things slower, more complex, and more frustrating for care teams.

We believe AI agents can change that. Our technology combines Large Language Models with system-level automation to handle real work inside existing hospital tools. No integrations, no disruption.

Our first agent automates coding workflows and frees up time for medical staff to focus on patients.

We launched in 2024, are backed by top investors (Index, Frst, Y Combinator, Hexa, Kima Ventures, Better Angle), and we’re just getting started.

 

The future of healthcare isn’t just digital — it’s automated. Come help us build it !

Context

We've closed a $20M Series A with Index Ventures and we're deployed in 40+ hospitals across France, with international expansion underway. Our product works, our clients are happy, and the pipeline is growing — but our marketing function doesn't exist yet.

This is our first marketing hire. You'll build the function from scratch and report directly to Paul (our CEO), working closely with Victoire on everything that touches Sales.

Your mission

Build Parallel's marketing from zero: give us real visibility in the healthcare market, and equip our Sales team with the assets they need to close.

Outcomes

In your first 3 months

  • Parallel has a consistent LinkedIn presence — at least 3 posts a week, founders included

  • Sales has a complete asset library: an up-to-date deck, a one-pager, objection-handling materials

  • A newsletter is live and sent regularly to prospects and clients

In your first 6 months

  • Parallel is present and visible at 2–3 key healthcare industry events (SantExpo or equivalent)

  • A content pipeline is running: case studies, op-eds, product announcements

  • Client communication is structured: onboarding emails, release notes, an upsell narrative in place

In your first 12 months

  • Parallel is a recognized voice in hospital digital transformation — prospects have heard of us before the first Sales call, and inbound starts coming in organically

You you are :

This job is for you if:

  • You write well in French and English, and you can get to the point

  • You can produce visuals on your own, without waiting on a designer

  • You're comfortable with email/CRM tools

  • You know how to prioritize in a fast-moving, still-unstructured environment

  • You're curious about the healthcare sector

  • Above all: strong writing, sharp synthesis, and proactivity — these aren't negotiable

You'll be embedded in the Sales team, reporting to Paul. There's no fixed plan to hire someone under you on day one, but managing a freelancer or intern down the line is on the table if it makes sense — to free up your time for higher-impact work, not as a given.

Hiring process

  1. Chat with Wallerand our recruiter - 30'

  2. Victoire our Sales Lead - 30'

  3. Case study, on-site + Chat with paul Paul - 1h30

  4. Ref calls

  5. Offer

Why should you join us?

  • You're the first marketing hire — everything you build, from positioning to process, is yours to define

  • Direct access to the CEO and a real seat at the table on Sales-impact decisions

  • No promises on progression, but a real trajectory if you prove your impact

  • Competitive salary + equity, Alan, Swile, and Apple equipment

  • A product that already works, real clients, and a market (hospital finance) where the upside is enormous

 
 
 

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Disclaimer: We're open to hire Account Executives across our Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes and Biarritz offices.

⭐️ The Account Executive (mid-market) job

We’re expanding our Sales team in France and are looking for ‘full-stack’ Sales to engage with prospects and turn them into happy Alan customers. You will join a team that focuses on companies from one of the following segments: Tech & Engineering, Business Services & Media, Retail, Transport, HCR, Learn & Care, Food & Beverage or Metallurgy.

You will interact with everyone from HR executives to CEOs.

Meet Hakim in this article to learn more about makes the Metallurgy segment so interesting for an Account Executive.

Why is our Vertical approach interesting?

  • Market potential: Vast and dynamic markets with significant structural challenges, offering fertile ground for a modern, tech-driven solution like Alan.

  • Team readiness: We've honed our go-to-market strategy over the years, and it's paying off with increasing inbound leads and active field marketing driving strong pipeline momentum.

  • Passionate teams: Our dedicated teams brings deep sector expertise and genuine passion for the clients we serve; every day in the field sharpens our edge and fuels our conviction.

  • Growth opportunity: The addressable market is enormous, offering virtually unlimited opportunities for growth.

What will you do with us?

You’ll own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. The average sales cycle is 4-6 months, dealing with companies ranging from 30 to 300 employees, with an average ARR of 150K€.

At Alan, Account Executives drive deals and close strategic opportunities with prospects. We sometimes handle some customer relationships to ensure the best possible onboarding. You’ll educate prospects, provide inspiring product demos, and onboard key stakeholders, making the transition from prospect to customer seamless.

We expect you to understand and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method. This method ensures the prospect experience is an integral part of the overall Alan customer experience—making it pleasant and delightful for everyone. We expect you to be instructive to prospects (Smart), as well as to define the best personalized high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

You’ll also help us grow and improve as a company, challenging us to enhance our product(s), methods, and strategy, and getting involved in initiatives to expand our customer base.

Meet Fanny Cibot who is Account Executive within the Business Services & Media Crew.


⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

You’ll be a great fit for the Metallurgy Team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 4 years of experience managing the whole Sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. Prospection is a key part of the role;

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above) and an advanced level in English.

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills;

  • Have empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems;

  • Can influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building;

  • Have a deep understanding of value drivers in recurring revenue business models;

  • Have a great attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team;

  • Are eager to learn fast and make an impact from day 1;

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level range.

If you're still wondering whether this could be the best move for you, take a look at this article from Lucie Leflour, our Sales Lead in France.


Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

About the Role

Imagine pioneering the mathematical and logical foundations that enable AI to fly safely in real-world, safety-critical aviation. As a Machine Learning Certification Researcher, you will address one of the most fundamental challenges in modern AI: proving that ML models are safe, reliable, and mathematically sound for deployment in autonomous flight. Your work will bridge the gap between cutting-edge statistical learning theory and formal aviation certification frameworks, building upon previous work (EASA CoDANN I and II, and FAA report DOT/FAA/TC-21/48), and putting real-world systems to the test.

At Destinus, we are shaping the future of defense through high-speed, autonomous flight technologies. We develop next-generation unmanned aerial systems that deliver greater speed, precision, and efficiency, supporting governments and defense organizations in mission-critical operations worldwide. Daedalean AG, the AI and autonomy hub of the Destinus Group, plays a key role in this vision—developing safety-critical AI systems at the intersection of advanced research and real-world aviation. Enabling machines to perceive, understand, and make decisions in real time, we combine aerospace engineering and artificial intelligence to build the next generation of autonomous flight systems, driving innovation where it matters most.

What You'll Do

• AI Certification Strategy: Analyze our existing AI certification strategy and help adapt it—or pioneer entirely new strategies—to certify different supervised ML.

• EASA Framework Alignment: Connect mathematical guarantees, technical arguments, and model evaluations to the EASA W-shaped process for AI certification in aviation, ensuring our research aligns with the latest regulatory guidelines.

• Theoretical Foundation & Modeling: Conduct research into statistical learning theory, generalization bounds, and mathematical guarantees for deep neural networks operating under dynamic real-world conditions.

• Uncertainty Quantification: Apply statistics and stochastic processes to model environmental uncertainties and sensor noise, and to quantify confidence in performance metrics.

• Literature & Proof Evaluation: Critically evaluate academic literature, mathematical proofs, and engineering assumptions with peer-review rigor to identify safety limitations and theoretical gaps in state-of-the-art AI.

• Regulatory & Audit Justification: Construct robust, logical arguments and technical justifications that translate complex, high-dimensional empirical data into structured evidence for safety audits and certification frameworks.

• Algorithmic Validation: Write clean, reproducible code in Python to test theoretical hypotheses, validate certification mechanisms, and benchmark model safety frameworks.

Requirements

What You'll Need

Machine Learning Theory & Mathematics

• ML Theory & Statistical Learning: Deep understanding of statistical learning theory, generalization bounds, and the mathematical foundations of deep neural networks.

• Statistics & Stochastic Processes: Strong background in advanced probability, statistical modeling, and stochastic processes.

• Python Engineering: Proficiency in Python with the ability to write clean, reproducible code (can also be learned on the job provided strong theoretical foundations and basic Python coding).

Research Rigor

• Scientific Research Methodology: Demonstrated capability or background in conducting comprehensive literature reviews, identifying gaps in current state-ofthe-art AI, and synthesizing complex academic concepts into actionable engineering frameworks (can also be learned on the job if you possess a strong quantitative baseline).

• Peer Review Expertise: Ability or experience in the peer-review process—capable of critically evaluating mathematical proofs, algorithmic assumptions, and research papers to assess their validity and limitations.

Education

• Currently pursuing or recently completed a Master’s, or PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, Theoretical Statistics, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a related quantitative research field.

Who You Are

• Critical Thinking & Healthy Skepticism: You possess a strong spirit of questioning everything. You naturally challenge conventional ML assumptions, probe for hidden edge cases, and refuse to take empirical accuracy at face value without rigorous proof.

• Logical Argument Building: You have an exceptional ability to construct robust, airtight logical arguments and technical justifications. You can translate complex empirical observations into structured, defensible evidence that satisfies strict

engineering and regulatory scrutiny.

• Thrives in Ambiguity: You are motivated by hard, unsolved mathematical problems at the intersection of theoretical computer science, safety engineering, and real-world flight operations

About the Role

As a Computer Vision Engineer in the Computer Vision Tracker team, you will join us at a very early stage, giving you a unique opportunity to heavily influence the technical direction of the team. Operating out of Lausanne, Paris, or Zurich, you will focus on creating a global 3D Object Tracking pipeline, at the intersection between the Computer Vision, Sensor Fusion and GNC teams.

 

Responsibilities

  • Computer Vision Algorithm Development: Research and implement state-of-the-art Computer Vision approaches to Object Tracking in multiple modalities and scenarios, combining classical and geometrical methods with AI detection models developed in-house.

  • Multi-Sensor Fusion: Fuse data from multiple sensors (Cameras, IMU, Radar, etc.) to provide high-precision target estimation and robust tracking through challenging conditions.

  • Edge Optimization for Low-Compute Deployment: Optimize and embed tracking algorithms on heterogeneous platforms with limited compute resources, ensuring real-time performance alongside other software bricks running on the drone.

  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Work closely with the GNC, Sensor Fusion, and AI teams to integrate your tracking pipelines into a seamless, production-ready environment.

  • Research & Innovation: Stay at the absolute forefront of scientific trends in computer vision, tracking algorithms, and sensor fusion to introduce cutting-edge methodologies to the product.

  • Mentorship: Depending on seniority, support the team by managing or mentoring junior engineers.

 

Candidate Requirements

  • Educational Background: A strong academic record with a degree in a STEM field (e.g., Computer Science, Robotics, Engineering, Mathematics).

  • Embedded Algorithmic Expertise: Proven track record in the research, development, and productization of Computer Vision & Sensor-Fusion algorithms in hardware-constrained environments.

  • Technical Competence: Strong proficiency in C++ and Python for real-time systems. Experience with optimizing code for edge deployment.

 

Nice to have

  • Highly structured, analytical, task-aligned, and research-oriented.

  • Excellent communication and influence skills, with the ability to effectively translate and present complex algorithmic trade-offs to downstream users and senior stakeholders.

  • Thrives under pressure in a fast-paced environment with a “no-task-is-too-small” mentality toward building foundational team infrastructure.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI’s mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

description:
About TetraScience

TetraScience is the Scientific Data and AI Company building Tetra OS, the operating system for scientific intelligence. We help the world’s leading life sciences firms turn fragmented scientific data into AI-native assets and scientific workflows that accelerate discovery, development, and manufacturing. TetraScience’s growing ecosystem of strategic partners includes NVIDIA, Databricks, Thermo Fisher Scientific, Snowflake, Google, and Microsoft.

In connection with your candidacy, you will be asked to carefully review “The Tetra Way,” authored by our CEO, Patrick Grady; it is impossible to overstate the importance of this document, and you should take it literally as you decide whether our mission, culture, and expectations are right for you.

What You Will Do

You will join TetraScience's forward deployed teams as a senior, hands-on engineer. In this role, you will work directly with biotech, pharmaceutical, and scientific companies, bringing advanced data and AI technologies into the labs that research, develop, and manufacture medicines. You will work alongside customer scientific, engineering, and IT teams to design, build, and ship integrations and data products on Tetra OS that serve scientific teams across the globe. You will also mentor other scientific data engineers, lead internal design sessions, and partner with Product Managers and Solution Architects to turn customer, product, and engineering objectives into commercialized solutions.

  • Act as a forward deployed engineer for a portfolio of biotech, pharmaceutical, and scientific customers. Own the technical relationship, understand their scientific workflows, and deliver solutions that move their programs forward.
  • Drive AI agents to design and build bidirectional integrations between Tetra OS and customer systems such as ELN, LIMS, MES, and process historians, including serverless push and pull pipelines, stateful connectors, and full stack data applications in Python and TypeScript.

  • Provide mentorship to junior scientific data engineers and show leadership on every front.

We hire Sciborg team members with potential, passion, and values alignment, not just a checklist of requirements. If you have related skills and a desire to learn, we want to hear from you.

Benefits

    • Competitive Salary and equity in a fast-growing company.

description:
About EH Group Engineering

EHG is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product is a significantly more compact fuel cell with high power density and lower costs of production. Faced with the challenges of climate change and the transition to a decentralised energy system, EHG seeks to provide high performance and cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To help bring this vision to life, we are looking for a Senior Control Engineer to coordinate our efforts in designing control strategies for containerized systems integrating our fuel cell technology alongside equipment such as gas reformers, batteries, and climate control units. You will coordinate the control team and play a key role in shaping how these complex, multi-equipment systems operate safely and efficiently in the field.

Based in the US? You’re welcome to apply. This is an on-site role in Nyon, Switzerland. We ask that you relocate within 3 months of starting, and we’ll support you with a relocation package.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate the control engineering activities and define the control architecture and technical roadmap for our fuel cell and containerized power systems

  • Develop control strategies, models and algorithms for test-benches, fuel cell system and containerized power supply systems using Matlab/Simulink and Siemens PLCs

  • Coordinate the transition of prototype control algorithms from Simulink to industrial-quality code in TIA Portal Step 7

  • Implement, tune and validate controllers for thermal, air, fuel and power subsystems

  • Define and own control requirements, state machines and safety/diagnostic logic

  • Drive the continuous improvement (performance, efficiency and robustness) of our products

  • Define and oversee model-in-the-loop (MIL) testing and validation procedures

  • Manage the complete software life cycle, from requirements through release and maintenance, including dataset management

  • Establish coding standards, conduct code reviews and ensure compliance with industrial and certification requirements

  • Coordinate and develop the control team, including task planning and prioritization

  • Act as the main control interface with embedded, test and electrical engineering, as well as external partners and suppliers

 

Skills and Experience Required:

  • BSc/MSc in control, electrical, mechatronic or automation engineering is mandatory

  • Minimum 7 years of experience in control engineering, including at least 2 years in a technical lead or senior role

  • Skill 1 : Strong experience in process control engineering, particularly with containerized power supply systems; knowledge of programming and implementing safety PLCs is a strong plus

  • Skill 2 : Strong experience with TIA Portal (Step 7, WinCC, Test Suite), with the ability to structure code to industrial standards and meet certification requirements

  • Experience with functional safety (e.g. IEC 61508, ISO 13849), including SIL/PL determination and implementation of safety functions

  • Experience across the complete V-model development cycle, including hazard and risk assessment, requirements definition, safety requirements specification (SRS), verification and validation, and dataset management

  • Experience with stationary and maritime power applications, with a focus on the US and EU markets and their respective standards and certification requirements

  • Proven team player, with the ability to:
    (i) Coordinate and mentor the control team by clearly explaining your code and helping the team adopt robust industrial methods: you will take the responsibility in developing Skill 1 and Skill 2 across the team
    (ii) Collaborate effectively within interdisciplinary teams

  • Solid knowledge of control theory, state machines and system identification

  • Strong experience with MATLAB/Simulink and model-based design is a plus

  • Professional working language is in English.

     

Start date: Immediately

About us:

Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights.

Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi.

About the role:

Restaurant owners generally aren't on LinkedIn and they don't read e-books. They ask friends, search Google, and more and more often, they ask ChatGPT. We need someone who can find new ways to reach them and get those ideas live quickly.

We're hiring a Growth Marketer to build and ship our organic and non-paid growth experiments. This role is for a builder, not a strategist. You'd rather ship a working test today than a polished deck next week. You'll take ideas from the backlog to live, measure them honestly, and double down on what works. Using AI and no-code tools, you'll build pages, tools and campaigns yourself instead of relying on agencies and six-figure budgets.

You'll report to the Head of Marketing, who sets direction and priorities. You'll work in deep collaboration with our other growth marketers, product marketing and creative teammates, plus embed yourself in the wider org of Sales, Account Management, RevOps, Product, and more.

What you'll be doing:

  • Ship growth experiments, fast: Take ideas from our growth backlog and get them live: landing pages, tools, ads and content. Run plenty of them, keep what works and kill what doesn't.

  • Get Tebi recommended by AI: Own our visibility in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini and Google's AI Overviews. Create and update content built to be cited, not just published, and track how often we show up compared with competitors.

  • Build tools operators actually use: Build free tools, calculators and templates for restaurant owners, and scale our programmatic landing pages. Use no-code, AI and vibe coding tools to ship without waiting on engineering.

  • Run creative campaigns: Help launch scrappy, unconventional campaigns across markets, from competitive campaigns to guerrilla and partner media, with the support of our Marketing team.

  • Turn word of mouth into a channel: Test referral and sharing ideas that turn merchant word of mouth into a steady flow of demo requests. Work with our Product Growth team to build the winners into the product.

  • Keep paid and organic working together: Support our performance agency with landing pages, creative tests and tracking.

  • Measure everything: Keep the experiment log up to date: hypothesis, cost, result and next step. Set up tracking and UTMs properly so we know what actually drove each demo.

How we'll measure success:

  • Experiments shipped each month, and what we learned from them

  • Demo requests from organic and other non-paid channels

  • How often Tebi appears in AI answers for our category, by market

  • Demos from free tools, the reservation widget and programmatic pages

What you’ll bring:

  • Think like a growth marketer but move like a hacker. You know what drives results and how to build just enough to prove it

  • Ship rather than spec. A working prototype today beats a polished plan next week

  • Have built and launched things yourself, like pages, tools, automations or campaigns, and can tell us what happened, including what didn't work

  • Already use AI to work faster and have a point of view on how it's changing the way people find products

  • Are hands-on with no-code and AI tools (Framer or Webflow, Zapier or Make, Claude or ChatGPT, Cursor or similar), without being precious about the stack

  • Are comfortable with data and honest about results, in GA4, HubSpot, Looker or whatever gets the answer

  • Have creative, sharp ideas and the discipline to ship the unglamorous parts too

  • Take ownership and don't wait to be told what to do. No task is above or beneath you

  • Speak fluent English. Another European language is a plus

Nice to have:

  • Experience with SEO, and with AEO or getting a brand cited by AI tools

  • Experience marketing to small businesses, or a background in hospitality

  • Vibe-coding projects you're proud of

We don't have a minimum number of years for this role. We care more about how you think and what you've built than how long you've been doing it. If this sounds like you but you don't tick every box, we'd still like to hear from you.

Benefits:

  • Start-up Equity

  • Competitive Salary

  • Lunch Provided in Office

  • Team building events

  • Unlimited time off

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How we use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

title: Total Rewards & People Business Partner
description:
People Business Partner & Total Rewards

Most People roles ask you to run processes someone else built. This one asks you to build them, and to own one of them outright: how Eye rewards and recognises its people. You’ll do that while partnering the part of the business where cybersecurity actually happens, with managers who are still learning to lead and specialists who know exactly how rare they are. If you need a mature organization around you to do your best work, this isn’t it. If you get energy from building one, keep reading.

The role

This role has two halves, and you’ll split your time roughly evenly between them.

The first half is Total Rewards. You’ll own compensation and benefits at Eye, including salary reviews, benchmarking, levelling, benefits and our equity program. There’s no finished framework waiting for you. You’ll shape it, make it hold up as we grow, and get us ready for EU pay transparency. You don’t need to be a reward specialist yet. If you owned reward projects before and want to make this your expertise, this is where you do it.

The second half is partnering. You’ll be the People Business Partner for our core business: security operations, incident response, customer support & onboarding, and project management. It’s the most varied population in the company: working students running shift rosters next to deeply specialized senior engineers, and managers at very different stages of their leadership journey.

That mix is exactly why this role needs presence more than years. You’ll coach a first-time manager on the basics one hour and align a salary band with C-level the next. You’ll need to be comfortable doing both, and to enjoy it.

What you’ll do

  • Own Total Rewards end to end: run the annual salary review, keep our benchmarks honest, and build levelling and salary bands that make sense to managers and employees alike.

description:

At Karl Lagerfeld, we are driven by Karl’s mantra: “Embrace the present and invent the future.”
 
Always contemporary and forward-looking, the House of KARL LAGERFELD shares the creative vision and design aesthetic of its iconic founder, Karl Lagerfeld.
 
We are the only fashion house that carries Karl’s name on its door and we strive to live up to this responsibility in everything we do, every day, with the utmost joy and passion.

At KARL LAGERFELD we’re committed to working toward the highest standards of sustainability and integrity across all areas of our business,. In 2019, KARL LAGERFELD joined as a founding member of the Fashion Pact, a global sustainability initiative seeking to transform the fashion industry through objectives in three areas: climate, biodiversity and ocean protection.

• Perform regular supplier statement reconciliations and proactively resolve discrepancies.
• Monitor AP aging balances and follow up on outstanding items to ensure timely resolution.
• Support month-end and year-end closing activities related to accounts payable.
• Ensure compliance with internal controls, financial policies, and audit requirements.
• Assist with internal and external audits by providing supporting documentation and responding to audit requests.

Team & Administrative Support

• Manage shared Accounts Payable mailboxes, ensuring effective communication and timely handling of requests.
• Process employee expense claims in accordance with company policies and approval procedures.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of Accounts Payable processes and finance operations.
• Support day-to-day Finance department activities as required.

Help ambitious Swiss businesses expand internationally by removing the complexities of cross-border hiring and workforce management. As an Account Executive, you will own the full B2B sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery to negotiation, closing, and successful customer onboarding. You will advise founders, HR leaders, and other decision-makers on workforce solutions that enable them to hire talent across borders compliantly. Working in a remote-first, international sales team, you will build a strong pipeline, develop strategic relationships, and turn complex business challenges into commercial opportunities. This role is designed for a results-driven sales professional who combines consultative selling with proactive outbound prospecting and confident deal management. You will have the autonomy to manage your territory, exceed ambitious sales targets, and contribute to the growth of a globally connected business.


Accountabilities:

Take ownership of the complete sales process across assigned Swiss accounts, building a strong pipeline and helping companies understand the value of international workforce solutions. Work closely with prospects and internal sales colleagues to identify business needs, navigate complex buying processes, and consistently achieve commercial objectives.

  • Manage the full sales cycle, from initial prospecting and discovery through qualification, negotiation, closing, and successful customer onboarding.

  • Develop and manage relationships with Swiss companies seeking to expand internationally and hire talent across borders.

  • Conduct thorough discovery conversations to understand hiring plans, business priorities, expansion timelines, and potential compliance risks.

  • Engage founders, HR leaders, and other key stakeholders, building internal champions and demonstrating the business value of proposed solutions to Finance, Legal, and executive decision-makers.

  • Apply structured qualification methodologies, such as MEDDICC, to assess opportunities, prioritize qualified prospects, and maintain a healthy sales pipeline.

  • Generate new business through proactive outbound activities, including cold calling, personalized outreach, and targeted prospecting around relevant business events and funding announcements.

  • Collaborate with Business Development Representatives (BDRs) to identify and pursue high-value opportunities within the assigned territory.

  • Maintain deal momentum through effective follow-ups, confident negotiations, and clear communication throughout the buying process.

  • Use AI tools to improve prospect research, outreach quality, productivity, and sales execution.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date CRM records, including pipeline activity, opportunity progress, and sales forecasts.

  • Consistently meet or exceed sales quotas while taking accountability for individual performance and continuously improving through feedback.

  • Contribute to team knowledge-sharing, collaborate with colleagues across international markets, and apply lessons learned from successful and unsuccessful deals.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate is a proactive, commercially minded sales professional with proven B2B SaaS closing experience and the confidence to engage senior decision-makers. You should combine strong discovery and qualification skills with a willingness to prospect independently, manage complex sales conversations, and deliver measurable results in a fast-paced, remote environment.

    • At least 1 year of experience closing B2B SaaS deals as an Account Executive, with a demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas.

    • Ability to substantiate sales performance with clear metrics, including quota attainment and closed-won results.

    • Native-level Swiss German proficiency and business-fluent English for the Swiss German-speaking profile; alternatively, fluency in both German and French for the German- and French-speaking profile.

    • Strong discovery, qualification, and consultative selling skills, with experience using methodologies such as MEDDICC.

    • Confidence and persistence in outbound sales, including cold calling, personalized prospecting, and engaging busy founders and senior stakeholders.

    • Ability to uncover customer needs, communicate business value, address objections, and navigate complex decision-making processes.

    • Strong negotiation and closing skills, with a proactive approach to maintaining deal momentum and achieving sales targets.

    • Familiarity with AI-powered tools and the ability to integrate them into daily sales workflows.

    • Experience using HubSpot or a comparable CRM, with strong organizational skills and consistent data hygiene.

    • Coachability, adaptability, and a willingness to seek feedback and implement improvements quickly.

    • Excellent communication, relationship-building, and time-management skills in a distributed working environment.

    • An existing professional network among Swiss founders or HR leaders is an advantage.

    • Previous experience in HR technology, payroll, Employer of Record (EOR), or other compliance-intensive solutions is a plus.

    • Additional French language skills are beneficial for engaging customers in French-speaking Switzerland.

    • Creativity and resourcefulness in identifying new ways to reach decision-makers and generate qualified opportunities.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive compensation starting from €50,000 gross annual on-target earnings (OTE), comprising 60% base salary and 40% variable bonus, depending on location, skills, and experience.

      • Fully remote working arrangement within approximately two hours of Central European Time (CET).

description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Kraken Customer

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimising resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

🏠 Where you'll fit in:

title: Sr. Solutions Engineer ( MSSP )
Senior Employer Branding Specialist
Analytics Engineer, Revenue, Purchase & Order
B2B Growth Marketer - Benelux
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're looking for a senior B2B Growth Marketer to build and scale demand generation for ElevenLabs in the Benelux Region. This is a hands-on, in-region role focused on generating enterprise pipeline, growing our brand with technical buyers, and creating programs that become benchmarks for B2B marketing in AI.

As our first marketing hire in the Benelux Region, your work will shape how Benelux businesses discover, evaluate, and adopt ElevenLabs. The goal is to build repeatable marketing engines that make ElevenLabs the top choice for every enterprise.

 

What you'll do

  • Build integrated B2B marketing campaigns end to end across Benelux priority industries from strategy and messaging through execution and measurement.

  • Localize and execute programs across ABM, content, events, webinars, partner/customer marketing, executive branding, product launches, and outbound - choosing the right channel for the problem rather than owning a single function.

  • Adapt global campaigns and messaging for the the Benelux market, and feed local insights (buyer behavior, competitive dynamics, regulatory context) back to the global team.

  • Partner closely with local sales and the global product marketing, growth, and design teams to keep messaging consistent and execute high-impact campaigns.

  • Own pipeline generation and campaign performance for the market, using data to measure results, run experiments, and continuously improve what works.

 

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience at a high-growth technology company - you've built and scaled B2B demand generation programs that created measurable enterprise pipeline, and you know what moved the needle.

  • Ownership Pedigree: You have implemented growth and marketing projects from start to finish and held yourself accountable for the ROI.

  • Deep knowledge of the Benelux market: its enterprise buyers, media landscape, and business culture, ideally with an existing network.

  • Work well without much process. This role spans multiple marketing functions and needs someone who sets priorities, spots opportunities, and moves quickly as our first marketer in the market.

  • Relentless commitment to excellence — a high bar for quality, clarity, and impact.

  • Curious about AI, follows the technology ecosystem closely, and has exceptional judgment on what makes marketing stand out.

title: Automation Engineer

Manager Operations Planning & Performance
description:
Bij Crisp hebben we een missie: eten met meer smaak bereikbaar maken voor iedereen. Daarvoor moet elke schakel in onze operatie, van warehouse tot voordeur, dagelijks naadloos op elkaar aansluiten. Als Manager Operations Planning & Performance ben jij de spil tussen wat de klant bestelt en hoe wij dat logistiek waarmaken. Je brengt alle operationele schakels samen in één strakke, integrale planning en bouwt mee aan een betrouwbare operatie die klaar is om slim door te groeien.

Wat je gaat doen

Je bent eigenaar van de integrale operationele planning. Je vertaalt verwachte klantvraag naar concrete capaciteit op de weg (hoeveel bezorgers hebben we per dag en per hub nodig?) en bepaalt samen met de Operations Manager de planningsstrategie voor de korte en middellange termijn. Je zorgt voor een strakke planning tussen Delivery, Retentie en Warehouse. Zo werkt iedereen vanuit dezelfde basis en tilt jouw scherpe blik onze processen naar een hoger niveau.

  • Je geeft leiding aan een team van routeplanners (werkstudenten en starters). Samen zorgen jullie dagelijks voor de meest efficiënte bezorgroutes. Jouw team staat in direct contact met de bezorghubs, het warehouse en de growth afdeling om de capaciteit af te stemmen

  • Je werkt nauw samen met teams door de hele organisatie, van Tech en Analytics tot Recruitment. Om te weten wat er speelt, ben je regelmatig te vinden waar het gebeurt: op onze bezorghubs en in het warehouse.

  • Je stuurt op operationele KPI’s (zoals Drops per Hour en Time per Stop) en beheert belangrijke kostenlijnen. Samen met de Regiomanager en Business Analyst Delivery blijf je ons bezorgnetwerk continu optimaliseren.

  • Je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor de lijn tussen ons warehouse en de hubs. Je onderhoudt de contacten met vrachtwagenvervoerders, stuurt op prestaties (On Time) en kosten (Cost per Drop) en maximaliseert de vulgraad.

  • Je kijkt altijd naar wat beter kan, houdt trends en innovaties in de markt in de gaten en draagt dit actief aan wanneer je hier kansen ziet. Je signaleert kansen in de operatie, maakt de impact inzichtelijk en leidt verbeterprojecten van idee tot implementatie, bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van servicetijd, automatisering van planningstaken of de inrichting van ons netwerk.

  • Je bent onderdeel van het Delivery team en rapporteert aan de Head of Delivery.

Dit ben jij

  • Je hebt HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau en minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring in operationele planning, logistiek of supply chain, bij voorkeur in een snelgroeiende e-commerce- of retailomgeving.

  • Je beweegt je makkelijk door de hele organisatie, van de vloer tot het management. Je zoekt actief de samenwerking op en krijgt verschillende teams moeiteloos op één lijn. Je creëert draagvlak en krijgt mensen mee in een gezamenlijke aanpak, ook als je geen formele zeggenschap over ze hebt

  • Je bent sterk met data. Je duikt zelf in de cijfers, bouwt een model of dashboard als dat nodig is, en vertaalt analyses naar concrete keuzes voor de operatie. Ervaring met SQL, BigQuery en Data Studio is een pré.

  • Jij kijkt verder dan je eigen scope en overziet de hele keten. Je begrijpt hoe een keuze in de planning doorwerkt in het warehouse, op de weg en bij de klant, en je weet de juiste balans te vinden tussen kosten en kwaliteit.

  • Je bent resultaatgericht en weet wat het is om eigenaarschap te nemen. Jij maakt dingen graag makkelijk en concreet. Complexe vraagstukken zet jij gemakkelijk om naar begrijpelijke acties.

  • Je houdt het hoofd koel als het even spannend wordt. Pieken, onverwachte uitval of last-minute wijzigingen brengen je niet van je stuk; je prioriteert, plant opnieuw en zorgt dat de operatie doordraait.

  • Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.

Wat wij bieden

  • Werken bij een B Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op het Europese voedselsysteem.

  • 27 vakantiedagen om bij te komen en op te laden.

  • Een extra vrije dag per jaar om je in te zetten voor vrijwilligerswerk en iets goeds te doen.

  • Aandacht voor je mentale gezondheid met online begeleiding van erkende psychologen via OpenUp.

  • Voor straks een perfect pensioen via BPFL.

  • Elke maand food for thought, met workshops en talks via de Crisp University.

  • Regelmatig tastings of workshops op kantoor of bij een van onze leveranciers, om te zien hoe onze lekkerste producten worden gemaakt – en natuurlijk ook te proeven.

  • Dagelijks een uitgebreide, georganiseerde lunch op kantoor.

  • Enthousiaste, slimme collega’s en tijd om elkaar te leren kennen tijdens sport, events en proeverijen.

  • En... fikse korting op je Crisp boodschappen, omdat je thuis natuurlijk ook goed wilt eten.

Onze selectieprocedure

Solliciteer via onderstaande button. Hoe meer je kunt delen over jezelf en de reden dat je solliciteert, hoe beter.
Bij Crisp streven we naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen welkom is, ongeacht hun achtergrond, geslacht, leeftijd, etniciteit, seksuele geaardheid, religie of beperking. Wij moedigen sollicitanten met diverse perspectieven en achtergronden aan om te solliciteren en geloven in gelijke kansen voor iedereen. We waarderen de unieke bijdragen die elke medewerker kan leveren en zijn vastbesloten om een inclusieve werkplek te creëren waarin iedereen wordt gerespecteerd en gewaardeerd.

title: Project Leider Bouw
description:
Monumental automatiseert de bouw met robotica en software. Onze missie is om de bouw software-defined en autonoom te maken – een toekomst waarin mooie gebouwen op maat in één dag verrijzen, met minimale inzet van handwerk.

We zijn een groeiend team van engineers, operators en technici, afkomstig van bedrijven als Palantir, Qualcomm, Dyson, Shopify, Tesla, Meta en Google DeepMind. We staan nog aan het begin van het opbouwen van dit bedrijf, en dit is je kans om buitenproportioneel veel impact te maken op een probleem dat écht uitmaakt. Vanaf dag één werk je samen met een ervaren foundingteam, met een Series B van $32M achter ons onder leiding van Khosla Ventures en Plural.

Monumental zit in het centrum van Amsterdam, in een prachtig pand met een volledig uitgeruste werkplaats en een eigen testvloer voor robots. We bouwen de hele stack in-house – hardware én software. We zijn uitdrukkelijk geen hybride of remote-first bedrijf: robots en muren bouw je niet vanaf je keukentafel, dus we werken vijf dagen per week op locatie.

Lees meer over waarom wij vinden dat je je tijd aan de bouw zou moeten besteden, en over onze visie en ons bedrijf. Misschien vind je ons YouTube-kanaal interessant, de film van Based in Europe over hoe we het Europese woningtekort aanpakken, of deze video van Andreas Klinger over hoe ons kantoor eruitziet.

Over de functie

De afgelopen jaren is Monumental gegroeid van een werkend product en de eerste proefprojecten naar bouwen op grote schaal. Inmiddels hebben we een vloot van meer dan 150 robots, die metselwerk hebben uitgevoerd voor meer dan 90 woningen, een school, een buurthuis, een hotel en meer dan 150 meter kanaalwand.

Elke maand nemen we meer bouwprojecten aan, intern noemen we die ‘deployments’. We werken met meer robots en meer mensen en breiden vanuit Nederland uit naar het Verenigd Koninkrijk en de VS.

Als Hub Lead zet je onze eerste vestiging buiten het hoofdkantoor op, in het noorden van Nederland. Je begint met ons grootste bouwproject tot nu toe. Naarmate er meer projecten bijkomen, bouw je het team en de operatie verder uit.

We zoeken mensen die breed inzetbaar zijn en een bouwproject willen leiden alsof het hun eigen bedrijf is. Achter elk project staat een Deployment Manager die van begin tot eind verantwoordelijk is. In de praktijk vervul je vijf rollen tegelijk: uitvoerder, operationeel manager, accountmanager, analist en projectmanager. Je maakt het bouwplan, voert het met je team als onderaannemer uit, onderhoudt het contact met de aannemer en zorgt dat we goed metselwerk op tijd opleveren. Dat doe je in de bouw, waar plannen voortdurend veranderen. Uiteindelijk leid je meerdere projecten tegelijk, waaronder complexe projecten waarbij veel op het spel staat.

De ene dag sta je bij zonsopgang op en ga je naar de bouwplaats. Je zaagt stenen, bewaakt de planning, stemt af met de hoofdaannemer en ziet je bouwplan steen voor steen werkelijkheid worden. De volgende dag zit je op onze vestiging, analyseer je de winst- en verliesrekening van je project en werk je aan systemen waarmee je bij het volgende project een betere marge haalt. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de oplevering en geeft knelpunten die je op de bouwplaats tegenkomt door aan ons R&D-team.

Dit is intensief, praktisch werk op locatie, waar je veel voldoening uit kunt halen. Robots gaan kapot, het weer slaat om en de aannemer verandert het plan. Jij zorgt dat de bouw doorgaat.

Je krijgt veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid. De rol past goed bij je als je eerder een bedrijf hebt opgericht, of als je een ondernemende functie zoekt waarin je veel invloed hebt op het resultaat.

Wat je gaat doen

  • De logistiek van een bouwproject plannen. Je bepaalt hoeveel en welke robots en mensen nodig zijn, stemt af met andere onderaannemers en maakt de dagelijkse planning. Tegelijk houd je het grotere geheel in het oog en begrijp je wat jouw keuzes betekenen voor de kosten en opbrengsten per project.

  • Op de bouwplaats het team aansturen, begeleiden en motiveren. Je onderhoudt het contact met hoofdaannemers en andere betrokkenen, vertegenwoordigt Monumental en legt uit wat we doen. Je schakelt net zo makkelijk met steigerbouwers als met de CEO’s van de grootste hoofdaannemers en onze engineers.

  • Operationele systemen opzetten waarmee elk project beter verloopt dan het vorige. Je ziet waar tijd en middelen verloren gaan, past processen aan en verbetert de marge.

  • Samenwerken met bestaande klanten en zorgen dat daar nieuwe bouwprojecten uit voortkomen. In de toekomst doe je dat ook voor aanverwante productlijnen buiten het metselwerk.

  • Verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor de winst- en verliesrekening van je project en voorstellen doen om de kosten en opbrengsten per project steeds verder te verbeteren.

  • Helpen bij het werven en interviewen van nieuwe robotoperators en deployment operators.

Wat we zoeken

  • Minimaal drie jaar ervaring startupervaring, als operator, manager, of founder.

  • Nederlands als moedertaal. De bouwsector is sterk lokaal georganiseerd, dus dit is een vereiste voor de functie.

  • Je communiceert helder en makkelijk met mensen met uiteenlopende achtergronden.

  • Je bent bereid om letterlijk je handen vuil te maken om het werk gedaan te krijgen.

  • Je komt snel in actie, zet door en krijgt dingen voor elkaar. In deze functie draait het vooral om uitvoeren.

  • Je kunt goed omgaan met hoge werkdruk. Op bouwplaatsen gaat regelmatig iets mis en staat er veel op het spel. Daar komt bij dat we nieuwe technologie inzetten waarvan we nog niet alle mogelijke storingen kennen.

  • Je denkt scherp en leert graag. Welke achtergrond je ook hebt, je zult in deze rol veel en snel moeten leren. Het werk kan elke drie tot zes maanden als een nieuwe baan voelen. Je leert veel over de bouw, robotica en werken in een snelgroeiend technologiebedrijf.

  • Je hebt ervaring met het aansturen van een klein team en weet hoe je mensen begeleidt en motiveert.

  • Je bent operationeel en analytisch sterk. Je kunt een helder operationeel plan uitwerken in een spreadsheet, een winst- en verliesrekening presenteren en verschillende scenario’s doorrekenen, inclusief de factoren die het resultaat bepalen. Je bent een sterke projectmanager.

Waarom Monumental?

Bij Monumental werken betekent vooroplopen in een beweging die de bouwsector wezenlijk wil veranderen. Jouw werk heeft hier niet alleen impact op het bedrijf, maar op de toekomst van hoe we bouwen. Als je gedreven wordt door innovatie, graag complexe uitdagingen aanpakt en klaar bent om echt verschil te maken, horen we graag van je.

title: Director, Expanded Access Program Operations
description:
About myTomorrows 

myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options.   

We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem.   

We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection.   

With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business.  

Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. 

The opportunity: Director of EAP Operations (Expanded Access Programs and Site Management)

This is a high‑impact leadership role at the heart of how myTomorrows delivers Expanded Access Programs (EAPs) globally—where operational excellence meets commercial acumen.

As Director of EAP Operations, you’ll own the end‑to‑end operational delivery of our EAP portfolio, integrating Program Management and Site Management into one scalable, outcome‑driven model. Beyond ensuring quality, compliance, speed, and resilience, you’ll be expected to think like an entrepreneur: spotting opportunities, optimising processes, and driving commercially sound decisions that enable sustainable growth.

You’ll be a core member of the Operations Leadership Team and report directly to our COO (Vanessa says hi). This role is perfect for someone who thrives on complexity, builds high‑performing teams, and raises the operational bar—while balancing patient‑first decision‑making with a strong commercial mindset.

Geographic Requirement: This role is open to candidates in The Netherlands, United Kingdom, Canada and USA. For candidates in North America, to ensure seamless collaboration with our teams, applicants must reside within the EST or CST time zones.

What you'll do in this role:

  • Own the end-to-end operating model for EAP Program + Site Management, ensuring scalable and compliant delivery

  • Translate strategy and portfolio forecasts into capacity planning, org design and hiring priorities

  • Build resilient coverage and escalation models across the portfolio (no single points of failure)

  • Lead the EAP Program Management team to deliver consistent execution across clients and geographies

  • Lead the EAP Site Management team to ensure strong site engagement, workload balance and service performance

  • Drive standardisation and continuous improvement across ways of working, tooling and operational excellence

  • Set and run a strong governance rhythm: KPIs, performance reviews, risk management and quality oversight

  • Act as senior escalation point for complex delivery, regulatory and stakeholder challenges

  • Grow a bar-raising leadership bench through coaching, performance management and succession planning

  • Partner with Finance, People and Operations on budgeting, workforce planning and scale-up decisions

What you bring to the table:

  • You have 8–10+ years experience leading and managing expanded access programs.

  • Experience in a market access setting and with multi-country reimbursement strategies is a plus.

  • You understand the EAP business, and have a strong and proven commercial and client service mindset.

  • You have proven experience building and leading high performance teams.

  • You know how to lead managers and scale operational teams in complex settings

  • You have an exceptionally strong understanding of compliance, regulatory frameworks and operational requirements in the context of Expanded Access Programs

  • You have a track record of operational excellence: scaling delivery, managing risk, and raising performance standards

  • You are a strategic thinker with strong execution focus — you simplify complexity and drive outcomes

  • You are a confident stakeholder manager who can align senior leaders and external partners

  • You hold a high bar for quality and accountability, with calm leadership under pressure

What success in the first 6 months looks like:

  • Have full grip on the EAP portfolio and delivery realities — and you can clearly articulate the biggest operational opportunities and risks (and have recommendations on how to address them)

  • Create clarity across Program & Site Management: ownership, workflows, escalation paths, and what “great” looks like

  • Have strengthened the operating model to improve consistency, speed and resilience across the portfolio

  • Have managed to deliver on the expected ramp-up of the EAP business both in terms of patients served, and revenue generated.

  • Have implemented a clear KPI rhythm (quality, timelines, compliance, service levels) with transparent performance reporting

  • Have improved capacity planning and coverage, educing single points of failure and enabling predictable delivery

  • Have made at least 1–2 concrete operational improvements (process / tooling / standardisation) that measurably improve delivery outcomes

  • Are seen as a trusted Operations Leadership Team member who raises the bar and builds momentum.

Equal opportunities

myTomorrows is an Equal Opportunity Employer and, beyond upholding discrimination-free practices, we are committed to cultivating a workplace where difference and diversity are protected and celebrated. The best work comes from our best selves, and we go to great lengths in supporting our team members to be just that.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager (Former Auditor) - Dutch Speaking
description:
About the Role

Former Auditor - Senior Customer Success Manager

As a Senior Customer Success Manager (+Audit Background) at DataSnipper, you own the success of a portfolio of accounts - and you bring something additional to the role: direct experience in audit. You understand how audit teams work, what drives their priorities, and how to connect DataSnipper to the workflows that matter most inside a firm.

You are a reliable, independent operator who applies established CS frameworks and uses your audit knowledge to accelerate adoption, build credibility with audit stakeholders, and design enablement that non-audit CSMs cannot replicate. You manage onboarding, QBRs, health monitoring, and renewals with predictability and follow-through and you do it in a language audit professionals trust.

You may still be developing the full breadth of CS scope, but your audit domain credibility opens doors and unlocks conversations that are otherwise harder to access at this level.

 

About DataSnipper

Audit and finance are still massively manual and we are changing that. DataSnipper is a $1B, bootstrapped unicorn with 600,000+ users across 180+ countries, already embedded in the daily workflows of top audit and accounting firms.

Now, we are taking things further with our Excel Agent, bringing AI directly into where the work actually happens. Unlike generic AI tools, we do not sit on the sidelines. Our AI operates inside Excel, with access to real documents and audit evidence, meaning it does not just generate answers, it does the work, with full traceability.

We are not just applying AI, we are redefining how audit gets done. If you want to build something category-defining at scale, this is the place.

 

What You Will Do

  • Act as a Credible Audit Advisor: Serve as a trusted partner to Audit Managers, Senior Auditors, and engagement team leads. You are someone who understands customer workflows, their quality standards, and their firm's operating model. Translate DataSnipper's capabilities into language and use cases that resonate with audit professionals directly.

  • Drive Adoption Aligned to Audit Workflows: Run onboarding and training sessions that are grounded in how audit teams actually work - mapping DataSnipper features to real engagement tasks, sample testing approaches, and evidence management requirements.

  • Manage Account Health with Audit Context: Use product data, stakeholder signals, and your understanding of audit operating rhythms to monitor portfolio health. Recognize when signals carry firm-wide implications such as low adoption and respond or escalate with the right context.

  • Build Audit-Grounded Success Plans: Create success plans that connect DataSnipper capabilities to audit-specific outcomes: engagement efficiency, sample coverage, review cycle speed, and quality compliance. Align milestones to audit calendar realities and firm methodology, not just generic product adoption targets.

  • Communicate ROI in Audit Terms: Articulate the business impact DataSnipper delivers using metrics and framing that carry weight with audit professionals - time saved per engagement, risk reduction, quality improvement. Run QBRs and stakeholder conversations with the credibility of someone who has worked in the field.

  • Support Expansion Using Domain Knowledge: Identify expansion signals within your portfolio and use your understanding of firm structure such as service lines, team hierarchies, engagement types to surface credible growth opportunities. Support Sales in building ROI cases that resonate with audit leadership.

  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally with Audit Insight: Share audit workflow intelligence with Product, Sales, and Solutions Engineering. Surface patterns that require audit expertise to interpret - methodology gaps, adoption friction specific to audit processes, feedback that non-audit CSMs are less positioned to identify.

  • Contribute Audit Knowledge to the Team: Help peers understand audit customer context. Act as an accessible internal resource for audit-specific questions to help raise the team's collective ability to serve audit accounts.

  • Maintain Systems and Portfolio Data: Keep customer data, health signals, and portfolio records accurate and up to date in internal systems. Use this data to make better decisions and support reliable reporting.

     

What You Bring

  • Audit Domain Credibility: You have worked in or directly alongside audit teams. You understand engagement lifecycles, sample testing, evidence management, team hierarchies, and the quality standards that govern audit work. This is not background knowledge - it is something you apply directly in customer conversations and account planning.

  • Experience: Ideally you have experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a similar client-facing role in B2B SaaS, combined with direct experience in audit - whether as an auditor, audit technology specialist, or in a client-facing role embedded in audit workflows. You understand how audit engagements are structured, what drives adoption in audit teams, and how to speak credibly to audit professionals.

  • Audit-Specific Enablement Design: You can design and execute onboarding and training programs that map to real audit workflows - including audit cycle timing, firm methodology, and engagement team structure. This requires audit fluency that cannot be substituted with general CS experience.

  • Reliable Execution: You follow through. You manage a portfolio independently, hit your commitments, and deliver consistent outcomes without needing close supervision.

  • Data-Driven Approach: You use product data and health signals to stay ahead of risks and make decisions. You are comfortable in CS tools and CRM platforms.

  • Clear Communication across Contexts: You communicate clearly in both audit professional language and CS/GTM contexts. You can navigate stakeholder conversations with audit managers and firm leadership, and translate those conversations back into internal action.

  • Ownership Mindset: You take responsibility for your accounts and your own development. You ask for feedback, apply it, and look for ways to improve.

  • Collaborative Spirit: You contribute to the team including by sharing audit knowledge that makes peers more effective on audit accounts.

  • Adaptability: You handle change well. You adjust when priorities shift and keep a constructive attitude in a fast-moving environment.

  • Excellence in Communication: Professional fluency in English and Dutch (written and spoken), with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels - from audit associates to C-suite.

     

What we offer

  • Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact.

  • Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share in the company’s success and growth.

  • Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary.

  • 28 vacation days per year (full-time) to support your work-life balance.

  • Hybrid work model with at least 3 days onsite in our dynamic Amsterdam office.

  • Daily, freshly prepared lunches to keep you energised.

  • NS business card for easy commuting to the office.

  • A structured onboarding programme designed to set you up for success, including dedicated time to learn our product and customers before you hit the ground running.

  • Access to continuous learning and development initiatives to grow your skills.

  • Engage with a vibrant international team spread across seven global offices.

  • Company-wide events like DataSnipper GO, where global teams come together.

  • Access to Nilo, a mental health and wellness platform supporting your wellbeing.

     

Recruitment Process

  1. Recruiter Screen (30 minutes, online)

  2. Hiring Manager Interview (30 minutes, online)

  3. Assessment Interview (1 hour, on-site)

  4. Final Interview (30 minutes, online)

At DataSnipper, we believe great ideas come from different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and providing every candidate with a fair and equitable hiring experience.

Our hiring decisions are merit based and grounded in the skills, experience, potential, and capabilities relevant to the role.

We welcome applicants regardless of age, race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes you, you.

What matters to us is what you can bring to the role, the team, and DataSnipper
